# Silero VAD

`silero_vad.onnx` from https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad (`src/silero_vad/data/`, master on
2026-09-29; MIT, see LICENSE). Navi's Parakeet listener and the speech recognizer tester use it to tell
when you start and stop talking (`src/voice/vad.ts`). Copied into the extension as `vendor/silero-vad/`.
